label: TP
reason: User-supplied HTTP header names (via getName) and values (via getValue) flow directly into the HTML response string without any filtering or encoding. The doSomething function passes these unmodified strings to bar, which is then concatenated into the response. Since header names/values are arbitrary user input and ESAPI encoder is not applied to them, they can contain malicious scripts leading to XSS.

evidence.note: Header names and values are read from request and passed to doSomething without validation or encoding
